verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of installable official packages is Stripe's llms.txt, which tells AI agents to install Stripe packages from npm. Radar's REST API endpoints (reviews, early fraud warnings, value lists) are documented, but no evidence names official SDKs, their languages, or how they cover Radar resources. missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation (languages, installation, Radar resource coverage), SDK code examples for Radar objects, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use against Radar.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
